entities.summary: Alexander Germanovich Baunov is a Russian international policy expert, journalist, publicist, and former diplomat. Since 2015, he has been a senior associate at the Carnegie Moscow Center and later at the Carnegie Russia Eurasia Center, as well as editor in chief of Carnegie.ru and then of CarnegiePolitika.
